name: The Picture of Dorian Gray
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Picture of Dorian Gray was written by Oscar Wilde, first published in 1890.
Dorian Gray stays young while his portrait ages and bears the marks of his sins -- Wilde's only novel, controversial on publication for its themes.
Discussion prompt: Vanity is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
